raw_snippet: on the DDTL 5.5 Facility accrues for SOFR loans at an interest rate per annum equal to the Term SOFR plus an applicable margin of 5.5% or for base rate loans at the applicable base rate plus 4.5% per annum, at the Company's election. The DDTL 5.5 Facility matures in September 2031. Subsequent to the closing, the Company has drawn $1.2 billion.
